card.name: Words after the opening "Through"
card.fires_on: Words right after "Through" that start a phrase, such as "Through your library" in PhilPapers-style entry pages, or "Through the work of". Strongest on the noun after "Through your".

card.writes: It favors Chinese phrases like "的努力" and "不懈" (effort through work), and suppresses cause words like "所致" and " resulting".
card.plain: It fires on the words just after "Through" when the phrase means by way of something, such as "Through your library".
